# NannyElite

> Trusted childcare platform in Switzerland connecting families with verified nannies through AI-powered matching.

## About

NannyElite is a Swiss childcare marketplace that helps families find pre-vetted, verified caregivers. The platform uses AI-powered matching to connect families with the right nanny based on their specific needs, location, and preferences.

## Key Features

- **Verified Caregivers**: All nannies undergo ID verification, background checks, phone/email verification, and certification validation
- **AI-Powered Matching**: Intelligent matching algorithm considers experience, skills, location proximity, availability, and family preferences
- **Multilingual Profiles**: Automatic translation of nanny profiles into multiple languages (English, German, French, Italian)
- **Real Reviews**: Authentic reviews from verified families only — no fake reviews
- **Flexible Scheduling**: Weekday care, after-school care, date night babysitting, overnight care
- **Safety First**: Real-time AI safety monitoring of messages and verified family profiles for caregiver safety

## Services

- Weekday Childcare
- After-School Care
- Date Night / Babysitting
- Overnight Care
- Full-Time & Part-Time Nanny Placement

## Location

Switzerland (nationwide coverage)
